posts.headline: Eleven editions of roasting the African Bald Fraud and mjwithgoldhoops just keeps improving — now 9-2 with 1521.56 points, the clear best record AND the top score in the league.
posts.detail: This isn't a fluke anymore, it's a coronation — a 2-seasons, 4-average-finish pedigree is getting shredded in real time by a team that just won't stop climbing.

posts.headline: Eleven straight editions of burying Thicks and the reigning champ is still the least scary 7-4 team in captivity, sitting dead last in points-for among winning records at 1178.5.
posts.detail: A title and a 14-14 career record mean nothing when your offense can't crack 1200 through eleven games — the ring is starting to look like a museum piece.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's back-to-back-finalist dynasty just hit rock bottom at 3-8, and a 20-8 career record with a 1.5 average finish is now unrecognizable.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra was the gold standard of this league — 71.4% win pct, two straight title-game trips — and now he's buried in the Titty Committee cellar with 1187.78 points to show for it.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is 0-11 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has officially run out of commandments to break.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record says this franchise is usually just mediocre, but this season is a full-on plague — zero wins, 1181.06 points, and the belt is the only thing left with a pulse.

posts.headline: Nobody's talking about Shake N Bakers at 8-3 with 1511.84 points, and triciagloston is one win behind the league's best record without a shred of hype.
posts.detail: A 1-season, 6-7-1 pedigree says nobody should be scared, but the scoreboard's starting to disagree — nobody saw this quiet climb coming.
